name: Priya Paul
current_role: Chairperson & Executive Director, Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Ltd (The Park Hotels)
profile: Kolkata-born hotelier (b. 1967) who leads Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels, the hospitality arm of the family Apeejay Surrendra Group, operating The Park and Zone by The Park boutique hotels and Flurys. She succeeded her father Surrendra Paul as chair of the hospitality division in 1990; the company is now listed in India.
interesting_fact: Awarded the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian honour, in January 2012 for trade and industry.
deep_cut_fact: After graduating from Wellesley College she started at 21 as marketing manager of The Park New Delhi, working under her father, before taking over as chair in 1990.
notes: Listed company (NSE: PARKHOTELS); IR email is company's. She also sits on the boards of DLF Ltd and Apeejay Shipping per search results. Net worth source listed as 'Appejay Surender' = Apeejay Surrendra Group.

name: Yan Juran
current_role: Director, Wens Foodstuff Group Co. (SZSE: 300498); director, Guangdong Yuncheng Investment Holding
profile: Yan Juran (b. 1962) joined the predecessor of Wens Foodstuff, China's big Guangdong-based pig and poultry producer, in 1983 and rose through vice president, technical director and executive VP to president. He was president until around 2019/20 and remains a board director; he is one of the pre-IPO founding natural-person shareholders (2.80% in 2018).
interesting_fact: A Wens 'lifer': he joined the company's predecessor in 1983 with a high-school education and worked his way up to group president of one of China's largest livestock companies.
deep_cut_fact: Since 2005 he has been vice-chairman of the Beiying Charity Foundation of Xinxing County, Guangdong (广东省新兴县北英慈善基金会), Wens' hometown charity.
notes: Still listed as a Wens director in an Aug 2026 board resolution (https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2026-08-31/1225537760.PDF). Low public profile; no personal channels found. dsh@ is the Wens board-secretary office email.

name: Wen Muheng
current_role: Major individual shareholder, Wens Foodstuff Group (top-10 shareholder, 1.90% at end-2023); no executive role found
profile: Listed by Hurun as 温木恒 of Wens Foodstuff; Wens filings list a top-10 shareholder 温木桓 (Wen Muhuan), one of the company's pre-IPO top-50 natural-person shareholders, holding about 126.5m shares (1.90%) at end-2023. No biography or executive position found.
interesting_fact: Named in Wens' annual reports among the top-50 individual shareholders who held the company's shares before its stock-market listing.
notes: Character mismatch: Hurun 温木恒 vs filings 温木桓; very likely the same person but unconfirmed. Purely a shareholder, very private; only route is Wens board office.

name: Xing Weimin
current_role: Vice Chairman and co-controlling shareholder, Hunan Xiangjia Animal Husbandry Co. (SZSE: 002982)
profile: Xing Weimin (b. 1969) co-controls Hunan Xiangjia, a Shimen, Hunan poultry breeder, farmer and chilled-chicken processor, together with chairman Yu Ziwen under a 2012 concert-party agreement. He ran Baofeng poultry from 2001, alternated with Yu as chairman/GM of Shuangjia Nongmu 2003-2012, and has been Xiangjia vice chairman since Sept 2012; the company listed in Shenzhen in 2020.
interesting_fact: He and co-founder Yu Ziwen took turns as chairman and general manager of their predecessor company Shuangjia Nongmu for nearly a decade (2003-2012) before formalising joint control.
deep_cut_fact: Named a 2007 'National Rural Youth Entrepreneurship Leader' by the Communist Youth League Central Committee and Ministry of Agriculture, and also honoured as a 'National Model Agricultural Worker'.
notes: Company email is from the 2020 listing announcement (board secretary contact); may have changed. Search results (lixinger) indicate he is still vice chairman; the chairman is Yu Ziwen. Low media profile.

name: Kasra Nejatian
current_role: CEO and director, Opendoor Technologies (NASDAQ: OPEN), since September 2025
profile: Kasra 'Kaz' Nejatian is a Canadian former lawyer who co-founded and sold payments startup Kash, then joined Shopify in 2019, becoming VP of Product and (from 2022) COO. Opendoor named him CEO in September 2025 as co-founders Keith Rabois and Eric Wu returned to the board; he is repositioning the iBuyer as a software and AI company, and his SEC insider holdings drive his listed wealth.
interesting_fact: Opendoor's September 2025 hire of the Shopify COO came with a pay package Fortune reported could be worth up to ~$2.78bn if aggressive stock targets are met; he also publicly pledged to buy $1m of Opendoor stock.
deep_cut_fact: A Queen's University Smith School BCom '05 grad, he started his career as a lawyer before co-founding Kash; he has said his mother runs her own business on Shopify.
notes: Very active and candid on X (@CanadaKaz); that is likely the best route. Fortune pay figure taken from search-result summary of the Fortune article (potential maximum, not guaranteed).

name: Qu Lirong
current_role: Co-controlling shareholder (21.34%), Shandong Xiantan Group (SZSE: 002746); no executive post found
profile: Qu Lirong is one of the actual controllers of Shandong Xiantan Group, a Yantai-based white-feather broiler company spanning feed, breeding, hatching, farming, slaughter and chicken processing. She holds about 21.34% (183.6m shares) and acts in concert with her husband, controlling shareholder Wang Shouchun; Xiantan reported H1 2026 revenue of RMB 2.99bn.
interesting_fact: Xiantan says it has more than twenty years of experience in white-feather broiler farming and slaughter, running an integrated chain from feed mills to chicken processing.
notes: Hurun lists the company as 'Xian Tan'. Shareholder only, no public profile found; approach via husband/chairman Wang Shouchun or the board-secretary office email.

name: Chen Mingjun
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder (56.79%), Thinkingdom Media Group / 新经典文化股份有限公司 (SSE: 603096)
profile: Chen Mingjun (age 57 per 2025 annual-report data) founded Beijing publisher Thinkingdom in 2002 with a four-person team. It became China's largest importer of Japanese books and published all of Gabriel Garcia Marquez's works in Chinese. He was re-elected chairman for 2026-2029 and holds 56.79% of the listed company.
interesting_fact: Starting with One Hundred Years of Solitude (new Chinese edition, 2011) and ending with the memoir Living to Tell the Tale in April 2016, Thinkingdom published all 17 of Gabriel Garcia Marquez's works in China.
deep_cut_fact: Thinkingdom started in 2002 with just four people, including Chen and Japanese PhD student Shizuko Saruwatari, whom he recruited from Peking University's Chinese department. Its first title, the Korean novel 'Chrysanthemum Fragrance' (菊花香), was China's No. 1 literary bestseller of 2002.
notes: Chairman term 2026-06-17 to 2029-06-16 per Sina Finance (https://finance.sina.com.cn/stock/aiassist/ggbd/2026-06-18/doc-inictxki3597694.shtml). Low personal media profile; corporate email main@readinglife.com is listed for the board secretary. Don't confuse him with Taiwan's 陳明俊.

name: Lu Weimin
current_role: No current role found; former co-owner (with Luo Aihua) of Shenzhen Huachao Investment Holding Group (华超投资)
profile: Lu Weimin and Luo Aihua jointly owned Shenzhen Huachao Investment Holding Group, which held about 29.85% of Shenzhen-listed Kangdaer (000048) after buying into it in 2002. In August 2019 Kingkey Group agreed to acquire 100% of Huachao from them, taking Kingkey's control of Kangdaer to 71.5% and triggering a tender offer at RMB 18.97/share.
interesting_fact: Kingkey Group's 2019 purchase of their Huachao holding company triggered a mandatory general offer for Kangdaer's remaining free-float shares.
notes: Hurun 'Hua Chao' = 华超投资. Very low public profile, no personal channels found. Huachao's period at Kangdaer involved a contested control dispute with Kingkey; avoid that topic in outreach. Whether he still holds significant wealth after the 2019 sale is unknown.
